name: FullServerFixVIP
description: Disconnects an AFK player to make room for a VIP when the server is full.
loadOrderNote: Supersedes LiF-x/FullServerFix and should not be installed alongside it: FullServerFix drops a full-server connection at onPreConnectRequest, which pre-empts this mod's onPostConnectRoutine idler eviction. Set to 200 because it inspects other connected clients' state and alters the server-full behaviour.
